object.attr: derived: CF-V46, the failure analysis's change to SRS-207, chosen over the review's narrower Q60 wording: a tag in issue form for a document not yet created becomes that document's issue once the document is added. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-275.
object.description: If an entered tag name has the form of an issue tag, whether or not the repository holds the document, the commit dialog shall refuse the name.
